comparison.objective: Move fragile upright tiles into a box efficiently; candidate separates media from washers.
comparison.physical_skill: Batch grasping and fragile-object transport versus granular screening with orientation-dependent apertures.
comparison.success_condition: All tiles upright in the box with few trips and no drops versus ≥98% media recovery without washer escape or spill.
comparison.reason: Batch transport does not test selective screening or bridge clearing.
